subject: biochemistry
title: Free radicals, antioxidants and cytochrome P450

steps.tx: **Reactive oxygen species** ladder from superoxide (one electron oxygen, chain complexes I and III Qo leak, NADPH oxidases deliberate) through hydrogen peroxide (dismutated, membrane crossing signalling) to hydroxyl radical (Fenton ferrous iron plus peroxide, no enzyme defence, nanometre range devastation) and hypochlorous acid (myeloperoxidase in neutrophil phagosomes). Nitric oxide plus superoxide makes peroxynitrite (prior lesson), completing reactive nitrogen species. Physiology uses nanomolar peroxide for signalling (insulin, growth factors reversibly oxidising phosphatases); pathology is dose, iron and compartment failure.
steps.say: Superoxide ladders through peroxide to hydroxyl radical by Fenton iron chemistry with no enzymatic defence. Physiology uses nanomolar peroxide for signalling, while pathology is dose and compartment failure combined.

nodes.label: Hydroxyl by Fenton iron (no enzyme: prevent iron free)

steps.tx: Defence enzymes compartmentalise: **superoxide dismutases** (CuZn cytosolic SOD1 (ALS mutations), Mn mitochondrial SOD2 (knockout lethal, protection paramount), extracellular SOD3), catalase (peroxisomal, high peroxide loads, acatalasaemia surprisingly mild with redundancy), glutathione peroxidases (selenium, cytosolic and membrane phospholipid GPx4 whose failure unleashes ferroptosis iron dependent lipid peroxidation death, cancer and neurodegeneration frontier), peroxiredoxins and thioredoxin recycling (NADPH). Vitamins E (membrane chain breaker regenerated by C) and C (aqueous, pro-oxidant with free iron caution), urate, bilirubin and melatonin scavenge non enzymatically.
steps.say: Superoxide dismutases compartmentalise by metal and location, while GPx4 failure unleashes ferroptosis death. Vitamins E and C regenerate each other across membrane and aqueous phases protectively in tissues.

steps.tx: **Chronic granulomatous disease** (NADPH oxidase gp91phox X linked commonest, p22/p47/p67 autosomal) cannot burst phagosomes, so catalase positive organisms (Staphylococcus aureus, Burkholderia, Serratia, Nocardia, Aspergillus) survive (their catalase destroys the little peroxide made, catalase negative streptococci donate peroxide and die), causing recurrent abscesses, granulomas obstructing gut and urinary tracts, osteomyelitis and colitis mimicking Crohn. Nitroblue tetrazolium historical, dihydrorhodamine flow diagnostic, interferon gamma and transplant or gene therapy definitive strata, itraconazole and cotrimoxazole prophylaxis standard.
steps.say: Chronic granulomatous disease cannot burst phagosomes, so catalase positive organisms survive characteristically. Dihydrorhodamine flow diagnoses it, with prophylaxis and transplant strata defining modern management pathways completely.

steps.tx: **Paraquat** redox cycles at complex I generating superoxide floods concentrated in lung by polyamine uptake (caustic ingestion, pulmonary fibrosis delayed death, oxygen worsens by substrate supply so titrated minimally), reperfusion injury bursts ROS on reoxygenation (xanthine oxidase conversion in ischaemia, reverse electron transport succinate mechanism at complex I in heart and stroke thrombectomy/thrombolysis eras), and radiation ionises water to hydroxyl radicals (radioprotector amifostine thiol logic). Iron chelation (deferoxamine in iron poisoning and transfusional overload) starves Fenton chemistry therapeutically.
steps.say: Paraquat redox cycles concentrated in lung where oxygen titration matters paradoxically. Reperfusion bursts radicals on reoxygenation, and iron chelation starves Fenton chemistry therapeutically in overload states.

steps.tx: **Cytochrome P450** mixed function oxidases (heme thiolate, NADPH cytochrome P450 reductase flavins, microsomal endoplasmic reticulum plus mitochondrial steroid forms) hydroxylate drugs, steroids, bile acids, vitamin D and carcinogens in phase I, often activating procarcinogens (benzo[a]pyrene, aflatoxin epoxide) and prodrugs (codeine to morphine by 2D6, clopidogrel by 2C19) while inactivating others. Carbon monoxide binding gives the four hundred fifty nanometre spectral name; phenobarbital and rifampicin induce synthesis through CAR/PXR nuclear receptors over days, grapefruit furanocoumarins suicide inhibit intestinal 3A4 within hours.
steps.say: P450 oxidases hydroxylate drugs and steroids while activating procarcinogens and prodrugs variably by isoform. Rifampicin induces over days, while grapefruit suicide inhibits intestinal 3A4 within hours dangerously.

steps.tx: Microsomal **ethanol oxidising system** (CYP2E1) handles chronic drinker ethanol overflow generating acetaldehyde plus ROS (explaining tolerance, paracetamol vulnerability at therapeutic doses in alcohol dependence controversies, and fatty liver oxidative injury) alongside cytosolic alcohol dehydrogenase (NADH metabolic chaos prior module) and peroxisomal catalase minor route. Pharmacogenetic extremes (2D6 ultrarapid codeine breastfeeding neonatal opioid death case, poor metaboliser clopidogrel stent thrombosis) close oxidation by proving electron and drug handling are one clinical subject examined together deliberately.
steps.say: CYP2E1 handles chronic ethanol overflow generating oxidative injury alongside dehydrogenase metabolic chaos previously. Pharmacogenetic extremes prove electron and drug handling are one clinical subject examined together deliberately today.
